szoveg_eredeti:
KPN , the largest Dutch telecommunications provider, has launched Mobiel AI with ElevenLabs.

For a plumber or hairdresser, every missed call could be a missed job. Mobiel AI transcribes voicemails, summarizes calls, and routes callers, all inside KPN’s existing mobile app.

To get Dutch right, our team and KPN fine-tuned our transcription model on more Dutch-language data, raising verification accuracy from about 50% to 90%. Voice data stays in the Netherlands, on KPN’s own network.
